edits.old: In the pre-state, the 'Description' textbox (ID 126) is visible but empty, while the Name and Title fields are already filled with 'Cyberpunk'.
edits.new: In the pre-state, the 'Description' textbox (ID 126) is visible but empty, while the Name field is filled with 'Cyberpunk' and the Title field is filled with 'Neon Harbor'.

before.overview: The agent is creating a new forum named 'Cyberpunk' on the Postmill platform. Having already set the name and title, this step focuses on populating the 'Description' field with the required text 'Welcome to the future' to satisfy the task goal before moving to the sidebar configuration.
before.state_transition: In the pre-state, the 'Description' textbox (ID 126) is visible but empty, while the Name and Title fields are already filled with 'Cyberpunk'. After the agent fills the textbox with 'Welcome to the future', the post-state shows this value populated within the description field, and the field gains a 'focused' state, indicating readiness for the next input step without any page navigation or modal changes.

after.overview: The agent is creating a new forum named 'Cyberpunk' on the Postmill platform. Having already set the name and title, this step focuses on populating the 'Description' field with the required text 'Welcome to the future' to satisfy the task goal before moving to the sidebar configuration.
after.state_transition: In the pre-state, the 'Description' textbox (ID 126) is visible but empty, while the Name field is filled with 'Cyberpunk' and the Title field is filled with 'Neon Harbor'. After the agent fills the textbox with 'Welcome to the future', the post-state shows this value populated within the description field, and the field gains a 'focused' state, indicating readiness for the next input step without any page navigation or modal changes.
